notes_for_editor: NRHP nomination PDF is not digitised (22 KB placeholder), so the building chronology rests on Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted; paraphrased) for 1847-1867 and 1857/1905 anecdotes, single-sourced. Annual reports before 1891 are not in the corpus. Disagreements: tower height (Lighthouse Friends 58 ft; USLHS 55 ft to light; record 18.0 m), oil house date (Lighthouse Friends 1913; USLHS ca. 1910), deed date (2009 vs 2010 donated), Sheffield 1945-48 overlapping Clark 1925-54 in USLHS roster. The 1896-97 volume's report on Hart Island's fog signal has OCR-garbled heading; read as Hart Island from the text. 1891-92 volume entry is not dated to a single year. Fire: Lighthouse Friends names Keeper Forget; the Bulletin names no individuals. Roster dates matched by position from the USLHS page. 'Lens status' unknown; no source says where the lens is now. Pandemic-era wording on owner's website is undated; current tour status not verified. Verifier 2026-10-22: Commissioner FY1919 report cited at scan 429 is printed p.29 (cited by scan page only); the 1928 Bulletin only announces the radiobeacon for 15 May, the May 1928 date comes from Lighthouse Friends.
